# Auto-Collapse Demo

A block with `autoCollapse` folds down to its title once it's done. Click it to show the block in full again, and the arrow beside its **ID** badge to fold it again.

## A titled command

<Command
  id="install"
  title="Install the tools"
  command='echo "Installing..."; sleep 2; echo "version=1.4.0" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
  autoCollapse
/>

## An untitled command

Without a title, a folded block shows its command in place of one.

<Command id="configure" command="echo configured" autoCollapse />

## A check that warns

A check that ends with a warning (exit code 2) is done too, so it folds, and stays yellow.

<Check
  id="disk-space"
  title="Check the free disk space"
  command='echo "Less than 10 GB free"; exit 2'
  warnMessage="Running low on disk space"
  autoCollapse
/>

## Without autoCollapse

This block uses an output of the folded `install` block, which folding doesn't hide from it. It stays in full once it succeeds.

<Command
  id="show-version"
  title="Show the version"
  env={{ VERSION: "{{ .outputs.install.version }}" }}
  command='echo "Installed version $VERSION"'
/>
